meanings.note: High-frequency Russian spatial or relational preposition meaning 'for', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Сказал, что его блюда едят только в ресторане.
examples.trans: He said that his dishes are eaten only in the restaurant.

examples.text: Мы же с тобой в кино ходили три раза.
examples.trans: After all, you and I went to the movies three times.

examples.text: А я часа через два к тебе заеду.
examples.trans: And I will drop by your place in about two hours.

meanings.note: Prefix 'до-' marks reaching a boundary or finishing the remainder of an action (stem 'рогой'). Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('dear').

examples.text: Не за что, дорогая Елена Павловна.
examples.trans: Not at all, dear Elena Pavlovna.

examples.text: Дорогая, чего-то я уже скучать начал.
examples.trans: Darling, for some reason I already started missing you.

examples.text: Это дорогая одежда.
examples.trans: These are expensive clothes.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian spatial or relational preposition meaning 'on, onto', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Я надеюсь, что у нас есть целая жизнь.
examples.trans: I hope that we have a whole life.

examples.text: Наш шеф уволил курьера по доставке еды.
examples.trans: Our chef fired the food delivery courier.

examples.text: У нас есть целая жизнь.
examples.trans: We have a whole life.

meanings.en: to be offended, to take offence
meanings.note: Prefix 'об-' ('around, about') marks encirclement or comprehensive action (stem 'идеться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'got offended', paired with 'обижаться'.

examples.text: Она обиделась.
examples.trans: She's offended.

examples.text: Не обижайся!
examples.trans: Don't be offended!

examples.text: Обиделась. У неё всегда так.
examples.trans: She's offended. She's always like that.

meanings.note: Negative prefix 'не-' ('un-, non-, not') (stem 'заметно'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Что, незаметно, плохо сыграл, ведь я просто клоун.
examples.trans: What, is it hard to tell, I acted poorly, after all I am just a clown.

examples.text: Он всё сделал незаметно.
examples.trans: He did everything inconspicuously.

examples.text: Только делай всё тихо и незаметно.
examples.trans: Just do everything quietly and inconspicuously.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'ыграть'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'played / acted'.

examples.text: Что, незаметно, плохо сыграл, ведь я просто клоун.
examples.trans: What, is it hard to tell, I acted poorly, after all I am just a clown.

examples.text: Но вы новички, мы сыграем короткий вариант, часа через два закончим.
examples.trans: But you are beginners, we will play a short version and finish in two hours.

examples.text: Актёр прекрасно сыграл свою роль.
examples.trans: The actor played his role wonderfully.
